warnings: 合成城市与需求生成机制未经真实城市校准；司机容量按桶近似，非逐车交通仿真。

weather.aggregation: unweighted mean across zones; counts are contemporaneous

overview.supply_semantics: available_drivers is a snapshot; never a count of distinct drivers over time

heatmap.supply_semantics: per-zone availability snapshot in this bucket

train.history_policy: Only observations strictly before each origin; earlier partition history is allowed

validation.history_policy: Only observations strictly before each origin; earlier partition history is allowed

test.history_policy: Only observations strictly before each origin; earlier partition history is allowed

diagnostics.objective: mean Poisson loss up to target-only constant plus L2 kernel penalty

shared_features.training_preservation: bias offsets the changed coefficient at the training feature mean; exact for constant inputs

adaptation.source: past observed demand versus frozen-model h1 hindcasts, strictly before each origin

interval.limitation: Empirical marginal residual band; temporal dependence and distribution shift can change coverage. Not a confidence guarantee.

metrics.evaluation_unit: forecast-origin × zone × horizon; overlapping targets within a partition are counted at each origin

model.exogenous_assumption: Future weather, traffic and supply use the last origin-available observation; calendar and scheduled events are known in advance.
model.validation_selection: Earlier validation MAE chooses epoch, count-loss candidate, seasonal baseline and blend weight; later validation calibrates bands when feasible; test only after choices are frozen.
limitations: Synthetic performance does not establish real-world accuracy.
Imported completed_trips labels represent observed served trips, not total latent requests.
Single chronological holdout; rolling-origin cross-period validation is recommended before production.

forecast.exogenous_assumption: Future weather, traffic and supply use the last origin-available observation; calendar and scheduled events are known in advance.

adaptation.source: past observed demand versus frozen-model h1 hindcasts, strictly before each origin

forecast.scenario_note: Overrides are caller-known assumptions; demand_multiplier is an explicit post-model scaling assumption, not an estimated causal effect.
